K-Message Connector

Send invoices on WhatsApp. Let customers ask Odoo their own questions.

Paste one private token and press Connect. The templates are written for you and submitted to Meta, the rules that use them are set up, and K-Message is told where to find this Odoo — in one step, with nothing to forward to anybody.

Setup is one field

There is one K-Message, at one address, so the addon already knows it. The only thing a customer has that Odoo does not is the private token, so that is the only thing the screen asks for.

Connect checks the token first — a key the platform rejects stops with an error and nothing is written — and then does everything that key turned out to be allowed to do. Choose what it sets up, beside the button, keeps a switch per part for anyone who would rather decide than be finished.

  • Five WhatsApp templates, in Arabic, submitted to Meta for approval
  • Five automation rules that use them, filled in
  • A webhook so replies and delivery news come back
  • Six assistant tools, each with its own revocable token
  • Two ready-made flow trees, for a plan with no assistant

Sending the invoice is already on

Post an invoice and the customer has it on WhatsApp within two minutes, with the PDF attached and a line in the invoice's own chatter saying so. The other rules — order confirmed, quotation sent, delivery on its way, payment received — arrive switched off, because we also messaged everyone about their quotations is not a surprise anybody wants.

Delete a rule by mistake and Restore the default rules puts it back. It only ever adds what is missing: a rule you edited keeps your edits, one you switched off stays off, and a rule you wrote yourself is never touched.

The other direction

Nine questions, nine switches

ping, tools, customer_lookup, invoices, invoice_pdf, orders, order_status, stock_check, delivery_status. Switch one off and it is refused with a reason — for the assistant, for a flow, for every caller at once.

Nobody can ask about somebody else

A personal question takes the phone number from the live conversation and answers only for the customer it belongs to. Identity is never a parameter, and a number that matches two customers matches neither.

Careful by default

  • Practice mode. Every message is prepared and recorded, and nothing leaves.
  • Tokens are fingerprints. Shown once, scoped to named capabilities, rate limited, revocable.
  • Signed webhooks. HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body; anything unsigned or wrongly signed is refused.
  • A slow WhatsApp cannot roll back an invoice. Sending is an outbox with retries and backoff.
  • It waits for Meta. A rule whose template is still under review sends nothing and fails nothing.

Requirements

Odoo 17.0 or 18.0 · a K-Message account with a WhatsApp number · wkhtmltopdf on the server if you want the PDF attached.
Letting K-Message ask Odoo questions needs Odoo on an address the internet can reach; sending invoices does not.

The Invoicing, Sales and Inventory parts install themselves beside this one if you have those apps, and stay away if you do not.
